comments.author: Oi!
comments.body:
Since I don't read Korean eithere, here is the text for steps 3, 4, and 5, from the game:

3. at the big dead tree:
The species, or a flying one?
There are traces of someone fighting and what looks like animal fur scattered around. The tracks look like they belong to only one species, so either it was a fight between two of the same animals, or one of them can fly. This looks like it was feeding, but there are no bones left. It looks like something has been dragged to the south east.

4. at the stacked boulders:
There's a pattern that looks like a fat rope has been rolling along and the same bits of animal fur are there again. It looks like the tracks up to here have turned into the creature that won the fight. The tracks head West.

5. in the south central area of the map:
Judging by the tracks and there being no bones left over of the prey, this animal certainly looks dangerous. It could be a threat to our progress through the new continent. From the piles of rocks on the North East coast of the South America West, you need to investigate the animal.
